series.name: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)
series.notes: LCD prints the TEXT alarm name (OV-G-V01, OV-TEM, PV ISO-PRO 01/02...). The matching hex number is what SolisCloud / the Solis support KB use for the same alarm. Hex map confirmed on the OFFICIAL Solis global support portal, category 'Alarm/Error Messages': https://solis-service.solisinverters.com/en/support/solutions/articles/44002299792-what-are-the-do-s-don-ts- (lists 1010,1011,1014,1015,1018,1021,1023,1027,1030,1032,1033,1034,1035,1037,1040). Reverse-GRID exists only on the 1-phase manual, not the 3-phase one.

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is above the configured protection window, so the inverter stops exporting.
meaning.ur: Grid ka voltage set kiya hua limit se upar hai, is liye inverter ne export band kar diya.

causes.en: Long or undersized AC cable between inverter and main panel
causes.ur: Inverter aur main panel ke darmiyan lamba ya chhota AC cable

causes.en: Grid voltage really high during peak solar export hours
causes.ur: Dopahar mein zyada solar export ke waqt grid voltage sach mein high ho

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure AC at the inverter terminals with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, phir multimeter se inverter ke AC terminal par voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the multimeter reading with the voltage shown in the LCD Information menu; a mismatch means a bad sensing circuit.
solutions.ur: Multimeter reading aur LCD Information menu ka voltage compare karein; mismatch aaye to sensing circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: If voltage is genuinely high, get DISCO approval before widening the protection limit in Advanced Settings > Select Standard.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage sach mein high hai, to Advanced Settings > Select Standard mein limit barhane se pehle DISCO se ijazat lein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: Grid voltage has fallen below the lower protection limit, usually during a heavy load or a weak supply.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage lower limit se neeche gir gaya, aksar heavy load ya weak supply ki wajah se.

causes.en: Weak distribution transformer or long feeder from the pole
causes.ur: Weak distribution transformer ya pole se lamba feeder

causes.en: Large motor or compressor starting on the same phase
causes.ur: Usi phase par koi bada motor ya compressor start hona

solutions.en: Measure L1-N and L1-PE voltage at the inverter while the fault is active.
solutions.ur: Fault chal raha ho tab inverter par L1-N aur L1-PE voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is normal but the LCD shows low voltage, the sensing circuit is faulty - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar reading normal hai lekin LCD low voltage dikhata hai, to sensing circuit kharab hai - RMA.

solutions.en: Tighten the AC lugs and torque-check the terminal; a loose neutral raises resistance and drops measured voltage.
solutions.ur: AC lugs ko tighten karein aur terminal ka torque check karein; loose neutral resistance barhakar voltage gira deta hai.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: Grid frequency measured above the upper limit so the inverter disconnects from the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency upper limit se upar, is liye inverter grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Generator running in parallel with the grid and set slightly high
causes.ur: Grid ke saath parallel generator jo thoda high chalta hai

causes.en: Wrong grid standard selected for the local DISCO
causes.ur: Local DISCO ke liye galat grid standard selected

solutions.en: Check frequency with a multimeter or clamp meter at the AC terminals.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par multimeter ya clamp meter se frequency check karein.

solutions.en: Compare the LCD frequency reading with the meter; a mismatch points to the sensing circuit.
solutions.ur: LCD frequency reading aur meter compare karein; mismatch ho to sensing circuit ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Verify the grid code in Advanced Settings > Select Standard; do not change it without DISCO approval.
solutions.ur: Advanced Settings > Select Standard mein grid code verify karein; DISCO ki ijazat ke baghair na badlein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: Grid frequency is below the lower limit; the inverter waits and reconnects when frequency recovers.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency lower limit se neeche hai; frequency theek hone par inverter reconnect kar leta hai.

causes.en: Grid overloaded by many air conditioners and water pumps
causes.ur: Bahut se air conditioner aur water pump ki wajah se grid overloaded

causes.en: Weak local supply during peak evening load
causes.ur: Shaam ke peak load par weak local supply

solutions.en: Measure frequency at the inverter AC terminals with a meter that reads Hz.
solutions.ur: Hz read karne wale meter se inverter ke AC terminal par frequency measure karein.

solutions.en: Switch off heavy loads for 10 minutes and see if the inverter reconnects by itself.
solutions.ur: Bhaari loads 10 minute ke liye off karein aur dekhein ke inverter khud reconnect hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it never reconnects, check the grid code setting and the AC connection.
solutions.ur: Agar kabhi reconnect na ho, to grid code setting aur AC connection check karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

title.en: No grid voltage / inverter no power on LCD
title.ur: Grid voltage nahi / LCD par power nahi

meaning.en: The inverter senses no grid voltage, or has no power at all on the LCD.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko grid voltage hi nahi mil rahi, ya LCD par bilkul power nahi hai.

causes.en: AC MCB tripped or main isolator is off
causes.ur: AC MCB trip ho gaya ya main isolator off hai

causes.en: DC input voltage too low, or PV+/- reversed
causes.ur: DC input voltage bahut kam hai, ya PV+/- reverse hai

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker and isolator first, then measure L1-N and L1-PE at the inverter terminals.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC breaker aur isolator check karein, phir inverter terminal par L1-N aur L1-PE measure karein.

solutions.en: With DC switch OFF, measure string voltage - above 120 V on single phase - and confirm polarity is not reversed.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke string voltage measure karein - single phase par 120 V se upar - aur polarity reverse na ho.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF until the screen blanks, then bring AC on first and DC after 60 seconds.
solutions.ur: Screen blank hone tak DC switch OFF rakhein, phir AC pehle aur 60 second baad DC on karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: PV string open-circuit voltage has gone above the inverter DC input limit.
meaning.ur: PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ki DC limit se upar chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Too many modules wired in series for cold-morning Voc
causes.ur: Series mein modules zyada hain, thande subah ka Voc un ke liye bahut zyada hai

causes.en: Inverter DC input voltage setting lower than the actual array Voc
causes.ur: Inverter ki DC input voltage setting array ke actual Voc se kam hai

solutions.en: DC switch OFF first, then measure Voc per string at the inverter DC terminals.
solutions.ur: Pehle DC switch OFF karein, phir inverter DC terminal par har string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Recalculate the string Voc at the lowest local temperature and reduce modules in series if needed.
solutions.ur: Local sab se kam temperature par string Voc dobara calculate karein aur zaroorat ho to series mein modules kam karein.

solutions.en: If the meter reads normal but the alarm persists, the DC sensing circuit is faulty - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar meter normal reading de lekin alarm rehta rahe, to DC sensing circuit kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The internal DC link voltage has risen above the limit, so the inverter shuts down.
meaning.ur: Internal DC link voltage limit se upar chala gaya, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Inductor connection loose or the gate driver board has failed
causes.ur: Inductor ka connection loose hai ya gate driver board fail ho gaya

causes.en: Grid loss while the DC bus is still charged from PV
causes.ur: PV se DC bus charged hone ke baad grid chala gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV completely before opening the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter kholne se pehle AC aur PV dono isolate kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure DC and AC with a multimeter and compare against the LCD Information readings.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se DC aur AC measure karein aur LCD Information reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the inductor solder joints and the driver board; replace the driver board if the readings are healthy.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke inductor ke solder joints aur driver board check karein; readings theek hon to driver board replace karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage is too low to run the inverter.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage itna kam hai ke inverter nahi chal sakta.

causes.en: PV voltage too low for the minimum operating window
causes.ur: PV voltage minimum operating window se neeche hai

causes.en: Half-voltage sensing circuit or sample-and-hold board fault
causes.ur: Half-voltage sensing circuit ya sample-and-hold board ka fault

solutions.en: DC switch OFF and measure each string Voc; string should be above the minimum DC input voltage.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke har string ka Voc measure karein; string minimum DC input voltage se upar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Compare the LCD bus reading with a multimeter; a big difference means RMA.
solutions.ur: LCD bus reading ko multimeter se compare karein; bara farq ho to RMA.

solutions.en: Check the half-voltage resistor divider and its connector on the sampling board.
solutions.ur: Sampling board par half-voltage resistor divider aur uska connector check karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The AC waveform is too distorted, so the inverter shuts down to protect itself.
meaning.ur: AC waveform bahut kharab hai, is liye inverter apni protection ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Non-linear loads on the same feeder producing high THD
causes.ur: Usi feeder par non-linear loads jo THD barha rahe hain

causes.en: Weak AC wiring or a loose earth connection
causes.ur: Kamzor AC wiring ya loose earth connection

solutions.en: Keep the DC switch OFF and measure AC voltage, then test the AC line for THD.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF rakhein aur AC voltage measure karein, phir AC line ka THD test karein.

solutions.en: Switch off other inverters on the same phase one by one to find the noisy device.
solutions.ur: Usi phase ke doosre inverters ek-ek karke band karein taake noisy device mil jaye.

solutions.en: Recheck the earth conductor and tighten the AC earth lug; if THD is normal, the power board is likely at fault.
solutions.ur: Earth conductor dobara check karein aur AC earth lug tighten karein; THD normal ho to power board kharab hai.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: Heatsink or internal temperature has crossed the limit, so the inverter derates and then stops.
meaning.ur: Heatsink ya internal temperature limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter pehle power kam karta hai phir ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Direct afternoon sun falling on the inverter cabinet
causes.ur: Dopahar ki dhoop seedhi inverter cabinet par gir rahi hai

causes.en: Blocked heatsink fins from dust, mud or a soffit above
causes.ur: Heatsink ki fins dhool, gadda ya upar ke chhat se band ho gayi hain

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the inverter with a thermometer; compare with the LCD internal temperature.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se inverter ke paas ka ambient temperature measure karein aur LCD ke internal temperature se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check heatsink airflow and clear any dust buildup; do not blow compressed air into the electronics.
solutions.ur: Heatsink ka airflow check karein aur dhool saaf karein; electronics mein compressed air na maarein.

solutions.en: If ambient is within range and the alarm still trips, the internal NTC sensor or fan is faulty - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar ambient range mein hai phir bhi alarm aata hai, to internal NTC sensor ya fan kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

title.ur: PV side ki insulation kharab, earth fault (PV ISO-PRO 01/02)

meaning.en: Insulation resistance on the PV side has fallen, so a DC earth fault is present and the inverter cannot generate.
meaning.ur: PV side ki insulation resistance gir gayi hai, matlab DC earth fault mojood hai aur inverter generate nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Panel frame or module laminate shorted to earth
causes.ur: Panel frame ya module laminate earth se short ho gaya

causes.en: Damaged cable insulation, a crushed conduit or a wet MC4 connector
causes.ur: Cable ki insulation kharab, daba hua conduit ya geela MC4 connector

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure each string's positive and negative to earth with a megohmmeter at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke megohmmeter 1000 V par har string ki positive aur negative line ko earth ke against measure karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all DC inputs and reconnect them one string at a time to find the faulty string.
solutions.ur: Sab DC input disconnect karke ek-ek string karke dobara lagayein taake kharab string maloom ho.

solutions.en: Note the weather when the alarm appears; insulation drops in rain or fog, so test in the same conditions.
solutions.ur: Alarm aane waqt mausam note karein; baarish ya dhund mein insulation gir ti hai, isi waqt test karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow alarm LED flashing + code on LCD

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: Residual current on the AC or DC side exceeded the limit, so the inverter locked out.
meaning.ur: AC ya DC side par residual current limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter lock ho gaya.

causes.en: Moisture ingress into the AC junction box or the DC combiner
causes.ur: AC junction box ya DC combiner mein paani ka ghusa hona

causes.en: Leaking RCD or a type-B filter capacitor failing
causes.ur: Leaking RCD ya type-B filter capacitor ka fail hona

solutions.en: Switch off AC and DC, then check the insulation of the AC cables and the inverter internal cabling.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC band karke AC cables aur inverter ki internal wiring ki insulation check karein.

solutions.en: Press the RCD TEST button on the board; if it does not trip, replace the RCD.
solutions.ur: Board ka RCD TEST button dabayein; agar trip na kare to RCD replace karein.

solutions.en: Measure leakage current with a clamp meter on the earth conductor while the system runs.
solutions.ur: System chalte hue earth conductor par clamp meter se leakage current measure karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The grid relay failed the inverter's own power-on self test, so the inverter will not connect.
meaning.ur: Grid relay ne inverter ka apna power-on self test fail kiya, is liye inverter connect nahi hoga.

causes.en: Grid relay or contactor welded / failed mechanically
causes.ur: Grid relay ya contactor weld ho gaya ya mechanically fail

causes.en: Relay driver circuit or 12 V supply rail faulty
causes.ur: Relay driver circuit ya 12 V supply rail kharab

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then listen for a relay click when power is applied.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir power dete waqt relay ki click sunhein.

solutions.en: Measure the 12 V rail at the relay board; below 11 V the relay cannot pull in reliably.
solutions.ur: Relay board par 12 V rail measure karein; 11 V se kam ho to relay reliably pull in nahi hoga.

solutions.en: If the relay is healthy, replace the relay driver board - RMA.
solutions.ur: Relay theek ho to relay driver board replace karein - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The DC component of the grid output current is too high, so the inverter disconnects.
meaning.ur: Grid output current ka DC component zyada hai, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Distorted or unstable grid supply
causes.ur: Grid supply distorted ya unstable

causes.en: AC cable or earth connection loose, creating a leakage path
causes.ur: AC cable ya earth connection loose, jis se leakage path ban raha hai

solutions.en: Check the grid is normal, then confirm the AC cable is properly connected and torqued.
solutions.ur: Grid normal hai ya nahi check karein, phir AC cable ka connection aur torque confirm karein.

solutions.en: Restart the system and see whether the fault returns; record the time of each event.
solutions.ur: System restart karein aur dekhein ke fault wapas aata hai ya nahi; har event ka time note karein.

solutions.en: If it returns with a healthy grid, the current sampling circuit or power board is at fault - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar healthy grid par wapas aaye, to current sampling circuit ya power board kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The inverter's internal 12 V auxiliary rail has collapsed, usually after a current leak to earth.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka internal 12 V auxiliary rail gir gaya, aksar earth par current leak ke baad.

causes.en: Current leaking to earth from a damaged cable or a wet connector
causes.ur: Kharab cable ya geele connector se earth par current leak

causes.en: 12 V SMPS transformer or its rectifier has failed
causes.ur: 12 V SMPS transformer ya uska rectifier fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then check the earth continuity of every external wire.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke har external wire ki earth continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the grounding conductor is solid and the inverter earth lug is tight.
solutions.ur: Grounding conductor solid hai aur inverter earth lug tight hai, yeh verify karein.

solutions.en: With power off, measure the 12 V rail at the control board; replace the SMPS module if it reads below 10 V.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke control board par 12 V rail measure karein; 10 V se kam ho to SMPS module replace karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The DSP failed initialisation, so the inverter never reaches the normal state.
meaning.ur: DSP initialize nahi hua, is liye inverter normal state par nahi pohanchta.

causes.en: Master and slave DSP holding different calibration values
causes.ur: Master aur slave DSP ke calibration values alag hain

causes.en: DSP connector on the power board loose or the DSP itself failed
causes.ur: Power board par DSP connector loose hai ya DSP khud fail ho gaya

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, wait until all LEDs and the LCD go dark, then DC switch ON.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, sab LEDs aur LCD band hone tak wait karein, phir DC switch ON karein.

solutions.en: With power off, reseat the main board, power board and DSP-to-power-board connectors.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke main board, power board aur DSP-to-power-board connectors dobara fit karein.

solutions.en: If it repeats after a proper reset, the DSP or power board is defective - RMA.
solutions.ur: Theek reset ke baad bhi repeat ho to DSP ya power board kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

title.ur: DC input current zyada ya interference (DC-INTF)

meaning.en: DC input current is abnormal or interfered, so the inverter shuts down.
meaning.ur: DC input current abnormal ya interfered hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: A failing PV module or bypass diode causing a partial short
causes.ur: Koi PV module ya bypass diode kharab jis se partial short ho gaya

causes.en: Insulation fault on the DC side combined with a surge event
causes.ur: DC side par insulation fault ke saath surge event

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure each string's positive and negative to earth to locate a ground fault.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke har string ki positive aur negative ko earth ke against measure kar ke ground fault dhoondein.

solutions.en: Run the system with one string at a time to identify the string causing the fault.
solutions.ur: System ko ek-ek string karke chalayein taake fault karne wali string mil jaye.

solutions.en: Measure string current in series with a clamp meter; a string far above its rating must be isolated.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter series mein lagakar string current measure karein; rating se bahut zyada wali string ko alag karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: Grid output current exceeded the limit, so the inverter stopped to protect the IGBT.
meaning.ur: Grid output current limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter ne IGBT bachane ke liye ruk kar band kiya.

causes.en: AC breaker or cable undersized, or a loose AC connection
causes.ur: AC breaker ya cable chhota, ya AC connection loose

causes.en: Grid short circuit or a large motor start on the same phase
causes.ur: Grid par short circuit ya usi phase par bada motor start

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure the insulation of the AC cable to earth.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke AC cable ki earth ke against insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker rating and the cable size against the inverter nameplate current.
solutions.ur: AC breaker rating aur cable size ko inverter nameplate current se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the cable and breaker are correct, the current sampling or power board is at fault - RMA.
solutions.ur: Cable aur breaker theek hon to current sampling ya power board kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The internal IGBT bridge drew more current than allowed; the inverter shut down.
meaning.ur: Internal IGBT bridge ne allowed se zyada current kheencha; inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid transient or a load step on the AC side
causes.ur: AC side par grid transient ya load step

causes.en: IGBT or gate driver degrading with age
causes.ur: Umar ke saath IGBT ya gate driver degrade hona

solutions.en: Switch off AC and DC, then verify the DC string Voc and the AC cable before restarting.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC band karke restart se pehle DC string Voc aur AC cable verify karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and confirm whether the fault returns immediately.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke dekhein ke fault foran wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it returns on every start, do not keep restarting - send for factory repair.
solutions.ur: Agar har start par wapas aaye, to baar baar restart na karein - factory repair ke liye bhejein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The grid current control loop lost synchronism with the grid, so the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: Grid current control loop grid se sync kho gaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Unstable or distorted grid voltage
causes.ur: Unstable ya distorted grid voltage

causes.en: Loose AC connection or wrong grid standard selected
causes.ur: Loose AC connection ya galat grid standard selected

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and frequency at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminal par grid voltage aur frequency measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the AC cable terminals are tight and the earth is sound.
solutions.ur: AC cable terminals tight hain aur earth theek hai, yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the alarm repeats, contact the installer for an RMA.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; alarm repeat ho to installer se RMA ke liye rabta karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: The grid current sampling circuit failed; this is an internal component fault.
meaning.ur: Grid current sampling circuit fail ho gaya; yeh internal component fault hai.

causes.en: Current sensor or the sampling amplifier on the power board has failed
causes.ur: Power board par current sensor ya sampling amplifier fail ho gaya

causes.en: Harsh grid transients or a surge event damaging the sensing path
causes.ur: Teek grid transient ya surge event se sensing path kharab hua

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check all cable connectors on the power board are seated.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke power board ke sab cable connectors fit hain ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the current sensor output voltage against the service manual before condemning the board.
solutions.ur: Board kharab karne se pehle service manual ke mutabiq current sensor ki output voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: This is normally an RMA item - internal component failure.
solutions.ur: Ye aam tor par RMA item hai - internal component failure.

notes.en: Hex number for IG-AD is not published on the Solis support KB list, so no alias is given.
notes.ur: Solis support KB list mein IG-AD ka hex number nahi diya gaya, is liye alias nahi diya.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

meaning.en: Line and neutral are swapped at the AC input, so the inverter sees reversed polarity.
meaning.ur: AC input par line aur neutral swap hain, is liye inverter ko polarity ulti dikhai deti hai.

causes.en: Line and neutral connected in reverse at the AC terminal
causes.ur: AC terminal par line aur neutral ulte connect kiye gaye

causes.en: AC connector pushed in the wrong way during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke waqt AC connector ghalat taraf push ho gaya

solutions.en: AC switch OFF, then confirm which AC terminal feeds the neutral bar of the main panel.
solutions.ur: AC switch OFF karke dekhein ke AC terminal main panel ke neutral bar ko kaun sa wire deta hai.

solutions.en: Swap the two AC conductors at the inverter and re-tighten the lugs.
solutions.ur: Inverter par do AC conductors aapas mein badal dein aur lugs dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the Reverse-GRID message clears.
solutions.ur: Restart karke confirm karein ke Reverse-GRID message hat gaya.

notes.en: This row appears only in the single-phase S5-GR1P manual Table 8.1, not in the three-phase table.
notes.ur: Ye row sirf single-phase S5-GR1P manual Table 8.1 mein hai, three-phase table mein nahi.

meaning.en: One or more cooling fans are not spinning, so the inverter will overheat and shut down.
meaning.ur: Ek ya zyada cooling fan nahi chal rahe, is liye inverter garmi hoke band ho jayega.

causes.en: Fan bearing worn or the fan blades packed with dust
causes.ur: Fan ki bearing ghis chuki hai ya blades par dhool ki parat hai

causes.en: Fan supply cable disconnected from the fan board
causes.ur: Fan board se fan supply cable disconnect ho gaya

solutions.en: Go to Advanced Settings > Fan Test and run the test while watching every fan.
solutions.ur: Advanced Settings > Fan Test mein jayein aur har fan ko dekhte hue test chalayein.

solutions.en: Power off, then spin each fan by hand; a fan that spins by hand but not electrically has a failed bearing or driver.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke har fan ko haath se ghumayein; haath se ghoome lekin bijli se na chale to bearing ya driver fail hai.

solutions.en: Swap the dead fan with a known-good fan, retest, then fit the replacement.
solutions.ur: Kharab fan ko chalte hue fan se swap karke dobara test karein, phir naya fan lagayein.
